root_cause: The previouslyFocused variable can be null when getActiveEl() returns null (no focused element). The Safari fallback only updates previouslyFocused when its tagName is 'BODY', leaving it null, so hide() cannot restore focus to the opener.
repair_strategy: Modify the condition in the show() method to treat a null previouslyFocused as needing the fallback to event.target, ensuring a valid reference to the opener is stored before the dialog is opened.
expected_accessibility_effect: Focus returns to the opener after closing the dialog with Escape, meeting WCAG 2.1.1 Keyboard, 2.4.3 Focus Order, and 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value.
verification_requirements: Verify that pressing Escape after opening the dialog via Enter returns focus to the opener button.
Verify that clicking the opener and pressing Escape also returns focus to the opener.
Ensure the existing Safari workaround for body-focused clicks continues to function correctly.
